items.t: Donalds calls David Jolly a 'fraud' at Stuart rally
items.x: Donalds focused much of his speech on affordability, saying Floridians want to be able to afford insurance and housing, find good-paying jobs and build their lives in the state.

items.t: Beachgoers in Martin County urged to stay out of water after high levels of fecal bacteria found: Officials
items.x: Water samples taken Monday showed unsafe levels of fecal bacteria at 10 locations, including Bathtub Beach and Jensen Beach. Officials say exposure could raise the risk of illness.

items.t: Martin County man sentenced to 84 years in child pornography, voyeurism case
items.x: Daniel Clark Warren was sentenced to about 84 years in prison after being found guilty on 82 counts, including child pornography and video voyeurism.

items.t: Martin County man charged with attempted murder after roommate slashed in neck with box cutter
items.x: A 32-year-old man is facing an attempted murder charge after deputies say a dispute between roommates ended with a man being slashed in the neck with a box cutter.

items.t: Man accused of slashing acquaintance's neck with box cutter in Martin County
items.x: The Martin County Sheriff's Office have identified the suspect accused of stabbing his acquaintance with a box cutter on Thursday night.

items.t: Car found in Delray Beach pond prompts water rescue
items.x: Crews raced to a Delray Beach pond early Saturday after a car was discovered in the water. One person was taken to the hospital after saying as many as six may have been inside.

items.t: A flurry of last-minute legal developments could impact midterm elections
items.x: A criminal probe involving one of the closest Senate races of the year is underway, while several legal battles continue over ballots from suspected non-citizens.

items.t: Belle Glade woman accused after argument with teen turns violent
items.x: A Belle Glade woman faces attempted murder charges after deputies say she pointed a gun at a 16-year-old and fired.

items.t: Pope Leo jokes he’s neutral on Villanova-Notre Dame matchup, but ‘Prevost has another opinion’
items.x: Pope Leo drew laughs by saying “the pope doesn’t take sides,” before hinting his former self still favors Villanova.

items.t: Rescue crews search Delray Beach pond after car found submerged
items.x: A car in a western Delray Beach pond triggered an urgent search early Saturday after a person who escaped said as many as six people may have been inside.

items.t: 1 dead, 6 injured in shooting at California Spirit Halloween
items.x: One person was killed and six others were injured after a shooting at a Spirit Halloween store in California.

items.t: There's new guidance on menopause symptoms like hot flashes. What women need to know
items.x: For the first time in a dozen years, a leading OB-GYN group has updated its guidance on managing hot flashes, night sweats, sleep changes and other disruptive symptoms that often come with menopause.

items.t: FAA restriction grounds drones, limits private flights during Trump visit
items.x: A Palm Beach-area flight restriction runs through Sunday as security increases around Mar-a-Lago and DJT airport during Trump’s visit.

items.t: INTERACTIVE: What ending daylight saving time would mean for you
items.x: Most Americans want clock changes gone. Explore the debate between permanent daylight saving time and standard time before Sunday's fallback.

items.t: Mostly dry Halloween weather is expected later today
items.x: Keep an umbrella handy early on Halloween, isolated morning showers could give way to drier trick-or-treating later in the day.

items.t: Residents evacuated from Russian-occupied Oleshky reach Ukraine after localized ceasefire
items.x: Evacuees from Russian-occupied Oleshky crossed into Ukrainian-held territory Saturday in a major rescue operation carried out under the most significant truce since Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine 4½ years ago.

items.t: Deer crashes through North Carolina laundromat window, startling customers
items.x: A deer crashed through the window of a North Carolina laundromat, sending customers scrambling for cover before fleeing through the same opening.
